root_cause: Selection registration was opt-in per label: only WidgetKind::SelectableText counted as a selectable, so plain Text under a SelectionArea was never collected, hit, painted or copied. Flutter's Text builds a RichText whose RenderParagraph registers with SelectionContainer.maybeOf(context); SelectionContainer.disabled gives a null registrar.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/text.rs: new WidgetTree::is_selection_label (SelectableText, or Text whose nearest selection boundary accepts children); is_selectable_text, selectable_text_ancestor, selection_area_ancestor, collect_selectable_texts and selectable_text_value accept such Text. painting/behavior/content.rs: RenderKind::Text paints its share of the static selection under its glyphs. tree/focus.rs (out of ownership): a registered Text can take focus from a selection gesture but is skipped by focus traversal.
harness: text__selection_area_long_press_drag: match with the Incular twin switched back to plain Text on both sides.
api_change: Added WidgetTree::is_selection_label; plain Text inside a SelectionArea is now selectable.
limitations: A standalone Text (no area) stays unselectable, as in Flutter. Registered Text does not show SelectableText's own focus/keyboard affordances beyond what the area provides.
note: Text residual pass. Confirmed by the text-selection worker's twin needing selectable_text_styled; harness/incular/tests/frames/text.rs twin restored to Text::new.
